system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: Rather than treating model context as a static concatenation of the system prompt and complete interaction history, openJiuwen processes available information according to current context pressure, task state, and content structure.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: These tasks are strongly tool-dependent, requiring agents to repeatedly inspect and modify files, interact with the terminal, and verify environment state.
env_context_strategy.note: Retrieval of prior experience also exists (Self-Reflection) but repository knowledge comes from tool exploration.

context_compaction.evidence_quote: Concrete mechanisms include dialogue summarization, incremental compression of large interaction histories, and full-session compaction.
context_compaction.note: Structure-aware reduction of logs/diffs -> tool_output_pruning; offloading to handles -> structured_checkpoint.

observation_format.evidence_quote: executes requested tool calls, records their observations, and exposes those observations to subsequent model steps
observation_format.note: README mentions image attachments and multimodal conversations for user input; tool observations documented as text.

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: invokes policyπ, executes requested tool calls, records their observations

tool_count.note: Paper mentions a 'broad set of out-of-the-box operational tools' but no enumerable count in available evidence.

edit_primitive.note: No edit tool definition in the provided evidence.

tool_schema_source.evidence_quote: External tool integration and Model Context Protocol configuration.
tool_schema_source.note: Built-in tool schema source not visible in evidence.

protocol_standardization.note: E2A is an in-house envelope protocol between Gateway and AgentServer.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: The Inner Loop follows a bounded ReAct-style interaction.
loop_primitives.note: Outer Loop gives multi-attempt rounds; Swarm Flow parallel candidates + review; LSP diagnostics feedback loop. Default single-agent ReAct.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: 任务拆解、规划与执行管理，支持 TodoToolkit 工具进行任务跟踪。

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: Cluster mode | Multi-agent collaboration mode, with a Leader orchestrating multiple specialized agents
multi_agent_topology.note: Cluster Mode is marked default in README; Agent mode is single.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: parallel() dispatches multiple agent branches concurrently and synchronizes their completion;
delegation_mechanism.note: Also delegated sub-agents share the execution substrate.

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: By default, tools ask for approval before they run. If you would rather not confirm every step, adjust the policy in [Tool Permissions & Security]
human_in_loop.note: human() operator in Swarm Flow adds mid-flow intervention.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: It maintains an explicit task goal across multiple execution attempts and determines whether task-level execution should continue.

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: Capability assets are built once and reused everywhere, search, install, remix, and publish Skills through the Swarm Skills Hub
long_term_memory.note: Coded from README prose only. The line number is unavailable in the excerpt. 'Skill Self-Evolution' also persists optimized Skill definitions. No evidence was found for file_notes or vector memory.

state_persistence.evidence_quote: Session information management, viewing and restoring historical chats, and deleting session history.

self_verification.evidence_quote: Language Server Protocol infrastructure provides mechanically derived semantic evidence after relevant code changes
self_verification.note: Goal Mode self-assessment (self_critique) and independent assessment (llm_judge).

retry_policy.note: Outer Loop repeats rounds until semantic acceptance or a hard cap; cap is secondary.

rollback.note: No undo/revert/snapshot mechanism found in the provided evidence.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: The interaction continues until the model returns an answer, execution is interrupted, or the configured step limit is reached.
termination_condition.note: Resource limits/budget evaluators in Outer Loop; dead-loop collapse addresses repetition but is context-level.

cost_controls.evidence_quote: Context Management can additionally coordinate with the inference layer through session affinity and KV-cache reuse.
cost_controls.note: team token budget and budget() operator give token_budget.

timeouts.evidence_quote: """Resolve the per-round timeout; an omitted/null value means no limit."""
timeouts.note: react.completion_timeout bounds each task-loop round; null by default means no limit.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: 管理本地 jiuwenbox uvicorn 子进程 — 由 ``/sandbox enable`` 触发启动.
execution_isolation.note: Runs locally on the user's machine (desktop/pip install); an opt-in jiuwenbox sandbox with a policy file can be enabled via /sandbox enable.

filesystem_access.evidence_quote: file access goes through a whitelist, and sensitive operations are intercepted

network_policy.evidence_quote: Web access, information retrieval, and browser tool invocation capabilities.
network_policy.note: No network restriction mechanism appears in the provided evidence.

permission_model.evidence_quote: Every step is under your control, tools require approval before execution, file access goes through a whitelist, and sensitive operations are intercepted
permission_model.note: Default is approval per tool call; whitelist and policy file (jiuwenbox policy_path) also reachable.

tracing.evidence_quote: System log paths, runtime records, and common troubleshooting entry points.
tracing.note: TUI /swarmflows run-tree monitoring exists; no OTel evidence in provided material.

replayability.evidence_quote: Session information management, viewing and restoring historical chats, and deleting session history.

eval_hooks.evidence_quote: Auto Harness | Evaluation drive end-to-end optimization of the Harness itself, which learns and improves in practice with no model-weight training
eval_hooks.note: No explicit benchmark runner file visible in the provided evidence.

guardrails.evidence_quote: Security interception and permission control for system commands, file operations, and tool calls.
guardrails.note: Context processors filter/compress outputs; Rails include security hooks.

target_domain.evidence_quote: openJiuwen, anopen-source coding-agent harnessthat addresses two complementary challenges:Structural ComposabilityandRuntime Adaptivity.
